functional_correctness.description: Evaluates whether the code solves the stated requirements and behaves as expected.

edge_case_handling.description: Assesses how well the solution handles edge cases related to the problem.

efficiency.description: Evaluates the algorithm's performance in terms of time complexity and space complexity where relevant.

robustness.description: Measures the solution's ability to handle unexpected inputs or situations without failing.

api_library_usage.description: Assesses the appropriateness of using libraries or APIs in the solution, especially against the task requirements.

readability_maintainability.description: Evaluates how easy it is to read, understand, and maintain the code.

error_security_handling.description: Assesses how well the solution handles errors and avoids potential security issues.
